summary: Tested mobile layout of /termos.html on iPhone 13 (390x844) and Pixel 5 (393x851). All requested criteria pass: .tm-card and .tm-box are transparent, borderless, and shadowless on mobile; content uses full viewport width; text left-aligned; no horizontal overflow; footer compacted. Desktop preserved with white card, border, and shadow.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer height on mobile is still ~941px which is large due to stacked content; if further reduction desired, consider tightening column gaps and widget internal paddings. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile flattening at max-width:640px is working correctly on /termos.html: .tm-card and .tm-box render transparent/borderless/shadowless, text is left-aligned, and full viewport width is used. No horizontal scroll. Footer .footer-widgets padding-top=26px and flex-direction=column. Checkbox and CONTINUAR button remain visible. Desktop unchanged (white card with border+shadow).
